- Strong commitment to meeting customer requirements.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- High attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Job description:

Why join us at Alliance?

- We value your time - great company culture where flexibility and work-life balance are valued
- Grow your skills and expertise - work for a company that supports your professional development
- Wellbeing allowance - we care about your wellbeing
- Social events - company social events
- Friendly workplace - enjoy working in a friendly, professional environment

About us:

Alliance Geotechnical is an established and highly regarded geotechnical and environmental engineering consultancy with a proven track record in providing engineering and testing services on large scale civil infrastructure projects. Established in 2003, we have over 150 employees based in our office and materials testing laboratory in Seven Hills, NSW. Alliance Geotechnical offers a great working culture and competitive remuneration package.

To learn more about Alliance and what we can offer you, please go to https://allgeo.com.au/about/#benefits.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly driven Geotechnical Engineer to join our established Sydney Geotechnical Engineering team of approx. 45 people. You’ll be involved in investigations, analysis and construction support, working alongside experienced engineers and scientists in a genuinely supportive, collaborative environment. Expect a combination of field, lab and office work with some travel to regional NSW sites when projects require it.

Key responsibilities

- Fieldwork planning including subcontractor engagement and preparation of documentation contributing to safe, efficient site operations.
- Supervision of test pit excavation and borehole drilling operations, soil/rock logging to AS 1726, sampling, in-situ testing and on-site 
coordination.
- Scheduling of laboratory testing, collation and interpretation of results with guidance and review.
- Preparation of factual logs, figures and draft report sections, participation in quality reviews to ensure high technical standards.
- Assistance with geotechnical analysis and provision of practical inputs for foundations, retaining structures, slopes, pavements and earthworks.
- Clear communication with internal teams and clients, seeking support and feedback as necessary.

You will experience engineering projects from concept through to construction—not just desktop work—as we support your development into a well-rounded geotechnical engineer or engineering geologist.

About you

- Tertiary qualification in Civil/Geotechnical Engineering or Engineering Geology.
- Driver’s licence and appetite for fieldwork (metro and occasional regional NSW).
- Clear written and verbal communication with strong time-management and organisational skills.
- Solid Microsoft Office skills and a willingness to learn industry software and data systems.
- Familiarity with Australian Standards (e.g., AS 1726) and a practical, safety-first mindset.

What we offer

- Flexible, people-first culture that respects work–life balance.
- Structured graduate development program and mentorship with clear feedback and on-the-job coaching (you will always know what “good” looks like, and why).
- Exposure to a wide range of projects ranging from small residential to major city-shaping infrastructure.
- Wellbeing allowance, regular social events, and a friendly, professional team.
- Real progression pathways with opportunity to grow into providing design inputs, construction phase services, specialist assessments and more.

Salary Range: $79,423 - $83,000

How to apply

Please send your resume, cover letter and a copy of your degree.
